source_policy: Objective and baseline reward inventories are cross-checked against published quest guides and DLC catalogs. Reward-slot attribution and exact drop rates remain unresolved until independently reconciled.
known_reconciliation_notes: Some older sources use inconsistent capitalization or minor title spelling; canonical names follow the established quest titles.
PQ 142 is associated with Ultra Pack 2 in the DLC catalog and quest guide despite older page indexing differences.
This pass does not decide the final-game total PQ count; late-update PQ numbering is handled separately.
